Description:
Playful whiskers cover the face of the Lynxfish. A slender frame and powerful tail allow for this fish to pounce on its prey similarly to its namesake.

Special:

Skillful Chum

Throw this catch back into the water to gain 25 Midnight Fishing for 30 sec.

Throwing multiple catches can extend this buff up to 5 min. Only active in Midnight zones.

Areas you can find this fish:
- Eversong Woods
- Zul'Aman

Fishing Pools:
- Bubbling Bloom
- Sunwell Swarm
- Surface Ripple

Rates:
- This fish is exceedingly common in open water.
